posts.headline: Fourteen editions in and Thicks still hasn't given me a reason to stop — 3-0 with 403.68 points is a champion coasting, not dominating.
posts.detail: A title in two seasons buys patience from everybody else, but not here — until Klint's Clipboard starts putting up numbers that match the ring, this is a 5.5-average-finish résumé riding a hot start.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's historic collapse somehow finds new basement floors every single week.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and a 1.5 average finish built Put it in Ra's contender reputation, and 0-3 with 348.4 points is burying it in real time — fourteen straight editions of this and the dig still isn't done.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh can't buy a second win, and the irony writes itself again.
posts.detail: A 4-10 career mark and a 12th-place average finish set the bar on the floor, and 1-2 with a league-low-adjacent 333.36 points says the untalented tenth is right on schedule.

posts.headline: The African Bald Fraud is 3-0 and, for once, I've got nothing but grudging respect to give.
posts.detail: mjwithgoldhoops has a modest 15-13 career mark and a 4-average finish, but 3-0 with 409.82 points this season is making the fraud talk sound premature — prove it wrong a few more weeks and the nickname needs retiring.;

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy way or the Hard Way is still the league's cautionary tale at 0-3.
posts.detail: Auntie Thomas's 10-average-finish career and league-worst 233.78 points this season aren't a slump, they're a pattern — four straight editions of this column saying the same thing because nothing's changed.
